coverage_assessment: Captured 18 saved French/English search-response records (Q001-Q017 batched and Q018 targeted) with 466 ordered result headers; 22 source cards cover weekly searches and multiple Guinean towns/sectors. Four exact pages were body-read. Open-web discovery is documented but not exhaustive; regional, sector, publisher-origin, turnout, event-boundary, continuity, source-access, and LexisNexis/official-baseline gaps remain. Search-level RFI robots block and S006 Cache miss are recorded without inferring a body denial.
